commentaries.author: Parimelazhagar
commentaries.text: Those without the good fortune to care for guests with their wealth and gain the reward of sacrifice guard that passing wealth with pain, then lose it and lament, “Now we have no support.” Even guarding wealth is hard pain, so he says they guarded it anxiously.
